changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant dataset entries that were either subsets of others (Europarl + Common Crawl is part of WMT14 Fr-En) or language pair notations rather than actual datasets. Kept only the core datasets explicitly mentioned.
Normalized 'bleu' to 'BLEU' for consistency with standard capitalization. The paper only uses BLEU as the automatic evaluation metric.
No LLM-based evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper focuses on automatic metrics (BLEU) and intrinsic analysis of embeddings.
No human evaluation was conducted. The paper relies solely on automatic metrics (BLEU) and intrinsic analysis methods.

overall_notes: The paper is primarily a machine translation study focusing on transfer learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. It uses BLEU as the sole evaluation metric and does not conduct human or LLM-based evaluations. The extraction was generally accurate, but needed some dataset normalization to remove redundancies and language pair notations that were incorrectly listed as datasets.
